name: image-tuner
title_zh: 图片摆位调半天？拖一下就能出 CSS 的取景器
tagline_zh: 别再为 hero 图居中、头像裁切反复改数值。可视化平移、缩放、旋转、镜像，调完一键复制 CSS。
tagline_en: Stop guessing pixel values for hero images, avatars, and banners. Pan, zoom, rotate, mirror visually, then copy.
desc_en: Universal interactive image positioning, scaling, and framing tuner HUD for pinpoint CSS, React inline styles, Tailwind classes, and JSON alignment. Use when positioning hero images, avatars, banners, cards, or character art to eliminate trial-and-error styling. Supports visual panning, zooming, rotating, mirroring, transform-origin picking, and one-click code generation. Triggers: "/image-tuner",
why_zh: 把「改代码看效果」倒过来：先拖到满意，再生成代码。transform-origin。
why_en: Inverts the workflow: adjust visually first, code second. Tricky properties like transform-origin and object-fit become direct.
limit_zh: 只处理单张图片的定位/缩放/旋转/镜像，不生成滤镜、裁剪导出或响应式断点。
limit_en: Single-image framing only (pan/zoom/rotate/mirror). No filters, no export, no responsive breakpoints. Outputs code snippets for you to paste manually.
title_en: Drag to frame images, get CSS/Tailwind code instantly
